messages:
tess_pm: Acme wants an EU-only low-latency variant behind a flag. Ask: safe canary plan, A/B checks for quality vs cost, and clear fallback ops.

omar_ops: We have limited eu capacity next month. We should reserve a tiny pool and allow burst to spot instances. Need instant kill-switch.

li_eng: Proposal: preflight shadow 12h (mirror 100%), then canary steps: 5% for 12h, 30% for 24h, 100% for 7d. Each step gated by metrics. Routing: region + tenant allowlist.

sasha_ml: Quality gates: mirrored eval pass rate >= 96% on Acme prompt set, hallucination delta < 1%, and semantic-diff < 2%. I will provide 120 prompts for preflight.

henry_sre: Ops gates: p95 <= baseline + 40ms, error_rate <= baseline * 2. If gpu_pool_util >= 85% route to quantized fallback. Circuit breaker: 3x error_rate or sustained p95>baseline+80ms for 10m -> auto-rollback + page.

li_eng: Add cost A/B: route 10% to cheaper quantized model (mirrored) to measure cost delta; stop if quality divergence > 2% after 24h.

tess_pm: Draft flag YAML (ops/devex review):
```yaml
flag: acme_eu_lowlatency
allowlist: ["acme_corp"]
region: eu
preflight_shadow: 12h
canary: [{pct:5, dur:12h},{pct:30, dur:24h},{pct:100, dur:7d}]
fallbacks: [{when: "errors>3x_baseline or p95>baseline+80ms", action: rollback},{when: "gpu_util>=85%", action: route_quantized}]
emergency: {kill_switch: true, ops_override: true}
reporting: ["latency_p50","latency_p95","error_rate","quality_pass","cost_per_1k_tokens"]
```

omar_ops: Preflight must include cache warmup sessions and long-context sims. I'll reserve the canary pool and add a 24h buffer.

henry_sre: I'll add paging: page #eng-oncall and #product-alerts. Runbook short: flip kill_switch, notify CSM, open rollback PR, escalate to oncall.

sasha_ml: I'll post the eval set here by EOD and run the shadow results.

li_eng: I'll open PR with the flag + routing + telemetry hooks today (ETA 48h).

tess_pm: Owners: li (eng), omar (ops), sasha (quality), henry (oncall). Revisit after preflight. :thumbsup:
